summary: Full backend + frontend E2E of Dynamic Field Management (Register Settings) plus regression. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests passed (schema CRUD, auth/RBAC 401/403, empty & duplicate validation, CSV/XLSX exports using labels & excluding hidden/archived fields, custom key persistence, plus regression on visitor/admission CRUD, dashboard, teacher roster/attendance, search, admission CSV). Frontend: /r/visitor Register Settings navigation, rename label (name -> Guest Name), add new custom field (Blood Group), Save -> new column + label reflected in table and Add-form, entry created and shown, Restore Defaults reverts columns while existing rows persist. All 14 supported field types render the correct input widget (text/longtext/number/currency with ₹/date/time/email/phone/dropdown/checkbox/yesno/image/file/signature).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py resolve_columns only skips hidden/archived when a custom schema exists; when schema is null it dumps raw doc keys (including id/created_at/created_by) as export headers. Consider using default REGISTERS field order for cleaner default exports.

PUT /registers/{name}/schema does not validate that AUTO_ID fields (e.g. student_id for admission) remain present; an admin could accidentally delete the auto-ID field via API (UI protects with locked=true).
server.py file is 498 lines and mixes auth, registers, teacher, dashboard, cron in one module — consider splitting into routers as it grows.

RegisterView.jsx `updateField` auto-fills related fields only for hard-coded keys (student_name/course/batch_id) which are the default names; if user renames the key via schema, auto-fill silently stops.
test_credentials: Admin: Bearer testsess_admin or cookie session_token=testsess_admin. Teacher: Bearer testsess_teacher.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Tests use TEST_ prefix and clean up rows + register_schemas in fixtures/after run. Verified schemas=0 and TEST_ rows=0 after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Session tokens testsess_admin / testsess_teacher already exist in db.user_sessions. Visitor register uses key 'name' (not 'visitor_name') by default in REGISTERS config. When testing frontend, set cookie session_token before navigating; confirm dialogs are auto-accepted via page.on('dialog', ...). PUT /api/registers/{name}/schema accepts arbitrary field keys; ensure cleanup via DELETE .../schema.
